name: My Office Adventures
source:
Interactive game where you help revive your father's dying business with your groundbreaking idea. Along with the ride, you are joined by many cute girls and hot milfs.

[From [url=https://thecoder1994.itch.io/my-office-adventures]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款互动游戏中，你可以用你的开创性想法帮助你父亲重振垂死的生意。在旅途中，许多可爱的女孩和热辣的熟女也加入了你的行列。

[来自[url=https://thecoder1994.itch.io/my-office-adventures]itch.io[/url]]
